label_notes: The three existing reviewed semantic changes were re-keyed after line-level canonical normalization. Their reviewed meanings are unchanged: revised 9066 tag, removed MECHANICAL INTERLOCK callout, and added NOTE 24.
known_failure_cases: A moved label that also changes substantially may still become a remove plus add because the second alignment pass deliberately requires very high text similarity.
The different_systems sample pair is flagged by the compatibility warning, but token overlap is only a heuristic and does not prove document identity.
OCR can misread dense, low-resolution drawing text; its confidence is recorded and reduces delta confidence, but it is not a full OCR quality guarantee.
